message: What's your refund policy for late orders?
reply:
Our refund policy for late orders allows customers to request a refund if the order is significantly delayed—specifically, if it arrives more than 45 minutes past the estimated delivery time. Refunds can be requested within 7 days of delivery and will be processed to the original payment method, typically appearing within 3-5 business days. 

If you need further assistance or would like to initiate a refund, just let me know!

message: How long do refunds take to process once they're approved?
reply: Refunds are typically processed to the original payment method and usually appear within 3-5 business days once they are approved.

message: What happens with the cancellation fee if my driver shows up really late?
reply: If your driver is more than 10 minutes late to the agreed pickup time, the cancellation fee is waived. You can cancel the ride without any charge in that case. If you have any other questions or need assistance, feel free to ask!
